Excluded lot 268037 ($6,500 umbrella stand, July 2024) as a rare decorated piece. Mark reads DiL/DIL, not DIK.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 4: underside glazed with stilt marks, script signature 'John Campbell / Tasmania' and initials 'DiL' clearly legible. lots.question_for_armitage: Please check the rim and both lug handles for chips, hairlines or restoration (Campbell values drop sharply with damage), and confirm the base signature is incised or painted under the glaze.
